verdict.rationale: Bitbucket ships AI features such as an AI code reviewer, AI-powered pipeline workflows and Rovo, so AI-agent governance is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence shows admin controls to enable or disable AI agents per group or instance, or allow/ask/deny tool policies. The only documented controls are general workspace/project/repo permissions and merge checks, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can enable or disable AI agents per group or instance and set allow, ask, or deny policies for the tools they can use
